read_policy: Public central brain files may be read without user private tokens.
write_policy: Central brain writes require filtering, validation, versioning and approval.
conflict_policy: Use revision/epoch preconditions and ownership leases. Never rely on last-writer-wins alone. Conflicting valid changes become MERGE_REQUIRED and preserve both provenance chains.
offline_behavior: Operator may execute already-leased work and append local events/evidence; synchronize through outbox after reconnect.
replication_model: INVENTHOR Main is System of Record; Windows Operator and cloud are versioned replicas.
idempotency: All work items and promoted knowledge records require stable IDs plus deterministic fingerprints.
